scope_boundaries: Use the data as a traceable benchmark-construction and model-evaluation resource under expert oversight.

Interpret classification and structured scores as trainability or contract-predictability diagnostics; deterministic JSON serialization is not model-generated validity and tool-sequence exactness is not executable-control validity.
Treat MinHash component isolation and instruction-surface grouping as lexical leakage controls. They do not establish semantic independence, expert target validity, or physical-label correctness.
Treat the OPF evidence as released-field and registered fixed-control replay evidence; it does not cover the full candidate denominator, full scenario ledger, or field deployment.
